text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Wh-What on earth was that just 
now!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Strength is welling up from deep 
within...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We can't just stand around here! Time for 
a one-on-one duel right now!
